name: io.github.freegamestore-online/mcp
description: Build, publish, and improve games on FreeGameStore from your editor: create_game/update_files (your model authors) or agent_build/edit_game (the VibeCode agent authors), plus deploy status, SDK docs, game info, session history, and a redacted per-account audit log.

tools.name: list_games
tools.description: List your published games (requires FGS session token)

tools.name: deploy_status
tools.description: Check GitHub Actions deploy status for any game (last 5 runs)

tools.name: game_info
tools.description: Get live URL, repo, store listing, and up/down status for any game

tools.name: game_quality
tools.description: Quality audit results for games (scores, load times, console errors)

tools.name: leaderboard
tools.description: Query a game's leaderboard — top and recent scores

tools.name: platform_guide
tools.description: Fetch the full SKILLS.md platform guide

tools.name: sdk_reference
tools.description: Quick @freegamestore/games SDK reference

tools.name: create_game
tools.description: Provision repo+R2 hosting+listing, scaffold any of 10 engine templates, push → live at <id>.freegamestore.online. Write tool: supports dry_run

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List files in a game's repo

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read one file from a game's repo

tools.name: update_files
tools.description: Write/overwrite files in a game you own → auto-deploys. Write tool: supports dry_run

tools.name: agent_build
tools.description: Hand a prompt to the VibeCode agent — it writes the code AND deploys. Write tool: supports dry_run

tools.name: edit_game
tools.description: Open one of your existing games in VibeCode and optionally have the agent change it. Write tool

tools.name: agent_status
tools.description: Poll a VibeCode agent build session — game id, deploy phase, live URL

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Show who you're authenticated as (and whether the server is read-only)

tools.name: list_sessions
tools.description: List your VibeCode sessions from the web console

tools.name: session_history
tools.description: Read the full chat transcript of one of your VibeCode sessions

tools.name: admin_list_sessions
tools.description: Platform admins (org members) only: list every user's VibeCode sessions

tools.name: admin_session_history
tools.description: Platform admins (org members) only: read any user's VibeCode chat transcript

tools.name: admin_send_prompt
tools.description: Platform admins (org members) only: send a prompt into any user's session on their behalf. Write tool

tools.name: delete_game
tools.description: Delete a live game you own (delist, drop route, archive repo). Destructive: requires confirm=<game_id>; supports dry_run

tools.name: discard_session
tools.description: Discard an in-progress VibeCode draft session. Destructive: requires confirm=<session_id>; supports dry_run

tools.name: mcp_audit_log
tools.description: Read your recent MCP audit events (writes, dry-runs, denials), newest first
